subject: german
title: Stamp 2: Refugees and 'Wir schaffen das'
welcome_lead: Stamp the 2015 refugee crisis and Angela Merkel's famous words.
meta_desc: A-Level German adventure on the 2015 refugee crisis and Wir schaffen das.

concepts.def: Refugee crisis of 2015 when over a million people sought asylum in Germany.
We can do this; Angela Merkel's response on 31 August 2015 to the crisis.
Asylum seeker; person formally applying for refugee status.
Welcoming culture; spontaneous public support shown for arriving refugees.
EU rule requiring asylum to be requested in first country of arrival.
Bundesamt fur Migration und Fluchtlinge; federal office processing asylum claims.

walkthroughs.body_html: Civil war in Syria and conflicts in Iraq and Afghanistan drove huge numbers towards Europe. On 31 August 2015, Merkel declared Wir schaffen das, signalling Germany would accept refugees.
Volunteers met trains at Munich station with food and clothing. Schools, hospitals, and businesses mobilised. Critics argued the scale strained resources and integration capacity.

Applicants are registered, housed in initial reception centres (Erstaufnahmeeinrichtung), then assigned to states. BAMF decides on protection status: full refugee status, subsidiary protection, or rejection.
